sets.folder: Core Objects/Reviewed Gadgets/Fluid Sword - Living Liquid v3
sets.prompt: A magical sword made entirely from living liquid, single isolated full sword diagonal from lower left hilt to upper right tip. A short worn leather grip and tiny ivory-brass emitter are the only solid parts. Above the emitter the blade is a suspended FLOW of translucent jade water, broad turquoise and pale lemon marbling swirling from base to point, organically rippling double cutting edges, bright thin luminous rim, little liquid tendrils winding around the base and several floating droplets alongside. Clearly sword-shaped with a broad flat tapered blade and sharp point, visibly liquid magic not green metal or gemstone. Soft restrained glow, Moebius fine ink drawing, flat gouache, cream background, practical adventure game reference, no hands, no figure, no lettering --ar 4:3
sets.review: Selected 1 and 4 for visibly flowing liquid blade and readable sword silhouette. Solid grip/emitter only; do not model the blade as green metal. Hand pose deliberately omitted. Earlier sword sheets rejected: inconsistent stowed state and ambiguous/reversed grips.

sets.folder: Core Objects/Reviewed Gadgets/Fluid Shield - Clear Separation v3
sets.prompt: Side profile mechanical concept illustration of a magical liquid shield and the left forearm wearing it. Forearm enters horizontally from left, closed gloved fist points right. A small ivory brass device rests on the BACK of glove. A short bent brass support arm reaches forward from the device to a central emitter positioned TWENTY CENTIMETRES beyond the knuckles. From this emitter a broad thin vertical oval plane of swirling translucent jade liquid expands, seen obliquely edge-on on the RIGHT of the fist. Show a large unmistakable EMPTY AIR GAP between all fingers and the shield surface. Entire fist and wrist stay to the LEFT and behind the liquid plane. Thin rippling pale lemon edge, turquoise swirls. Moebius clean ink and gouache, cream background, clear physical construction, no text, no additional views --ar 4:3
sets.review: Selected 1 as a separation/mechanism reference: fist stays behind plane, support arm spans the air gap. Shield top is cropped; this is not a full silhouette blueprint. Reject 2: hand intersects liquid. Reject 3 and 4: shield plane turns lengthwise along arm. All v1/v2 shields rejected as construction references: pouch-like storage, hand intersections or ambiguous front/back overlap.
